output_layout.spl/<root_namespace>/: Mirror of the analyzed source tree under the repository/package root namespace. Use --flat-spl-root to keep the legacy layout directly under spl/.
output_layout.spl/<root_namespace>/<source_dir>/__pack: Package/root-package SPL generated bottom-up from direct file cards and direct subpackage cards.
output_layout.spl/<root_namespace>/<source_file_name>/: File SPL generated from class cards, top-level function cards, imports, exports, and file graph evidence.
Top-level function SPL generated from source-level deep analysis.
Class SPL generated from method cards and class-level graph evidence.
Method SPL generated from source-level deep analysis.
output_layout.artifacts/method_cards/: Machine-readable method cards consumed by class aggregation.
output_layout.artifacts/class_cards/: Machine-readable class cards consumed by file aggregation.
output_layout.artifacts/file_cards/: Machine-readable file cards consumed by package aggregation.
output_layout.artifacts/package_cards/: Machine-readable package cards consumed by parent package/root aggregation.
output_layout.graphs/: Repository call graph, file/package dependency graphs, containment graph, and scope subgraphs.
output_layout.index/: Repository index, symbol table, and ownership relations.
output_layout.logs/: Parse errors, unresolved calls, LLM failures, and quality warnings.
output_layout.wiki/pages/: Compiled WikiPage JSON objects for entities, topics, workflows, and navigation.
output_layout.wiki/mdx/: Obsidian/Docusaurus-style MDX pages with JSON frontmatter and markdown body.
output_layout.wiki/LLM_WIKI.md: Single-file SPL-first wiki export for sharing. It preserves each page's complete SPL content as the primary body.
output_layout.wiki/LLM_WIKI.full.md: Detailed single-file SPL-first wiki export with complete SPL content plus source refs, symbol refs, graph refs, and link context.
output_layout.wiki/index/: Search index, page index, link index, backlink index, and sitemap.
output_layout.wiki/graphs/: Frontend-ready wiki graph, call graph, dependency graphs, and containment graph.
output_layout.wiki/frontend/: Dependency-free static wiki browser for local inspection.

recursive_policy.method: Reads source code, AST facts, and graph context.
recursive_policy.class: Reads compact method cards and class scope graph only.
recursive_policy.file: Reads compact class cards, top-level function cards, file metadata, and file scope graph only.
recursive_policy.package: Reads direct file cards, direct subpackage cards, package graph, and workflow candidates only.
